verdict.rationale: MotherDuck documents both a remote MCP server and a local MCP server (mcp-server-motherduck) that let agents run read/write SQL, explore schemas, and use natural-language analytics, with explicit tool details (query_rw), read-only restriction options, and a public GitHub repo for the local server implementation. This is well-documented first-party evidence of an official MCP server for agent connection; missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party verification of the MCP server's reliability beyond vendor docs.
